The Government of India has issued Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India), Order 2017 vide the Department for Promotion of Industry & Internal Trade (DPIIT) notification no. P-4502I /2/2017-B.E.-II dated 15.06.2017 (as amended on 19/07/2024) to encourage 'Make in India' and to promote manufacturing and production of goods and services in India with a view to enhancing income and employment. 2.
